site.sitedescription: Lake Grinnell is the headwater lake of a tributary of Wallkill River, which flows northeastward to the Hudson River. Surrounding vegetation: Appalachian Forest, mainly oak (Quercus)-dominated hardwood. forests, with high abundances of walnut (Juglans), maple (Acer), ash (Fraxinus), and hickory (Carya)
